checks.evidence: The CLI accepts only the nine fixed cell identifiers and derives every Cargo argument from in-source constants; manifests cannot select another command.
Every relative binding and the selected manifest must equal its committed HEAD bytes before reservation.
The runner reconstructs the archive inventory, proves every unchanged byte, verifies every modified or added ledger entry, and rejects symlinks or unlisted files.
Cargo.lock, every registry package tree, Cargo/Rust binaries, absent configuration search paths, --offline, --locked and an exact minimal environment are bound.
Each cell uses a process group, timeout, RSS ceiling with positive sampling, complete post-run group-absence check, and raw output plus receipt preservation.
Attempts are unlimited observational records in unique directories; a safety or engineering failure remains nonterminal, while missing cleanup leaves the item blocked for reconciliation.
Focused cells require exact named tests and harness counts; the full cell requires the four bound harness summaries totaling 162 passing tests.
Nineteen pure/mocked tests passed, covering RSS and cleanup failures, uncapped attempts, fixed sequencing, candidate semantics, count drift, durable receipts and spawn failure.

verdict.remaining_gate: Commit the exact patch package, independent patch review and all nine execution manifests.
